correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves the Strehl-summand valuation identity ν₂(T)=s₂(n)+c₁+c₂, where c₁ and c₂ are binary carry counts for a+k=n and 2a+b=n. Simultaneous carry-free addition corresponds bijectively to subsets of positions with two adjacent 1 bits, giving 2^t(n) minimal summands. Their normalized sum is odd exactly if t(n)=0. Fibonacci no-adjacent-ones count and density-one divisibility then follow. Independently re-evaluated exact integers for n=0..71; this is corroboration, not a proof of all n.
